# Kerblabs

> AI marketing automation for UK local businesses (dental, hair, contractors, estate agents, aesthetic clinics, vets, opticians, solicitors, accountants and 20+ more) and US med spas. Eight bundled AI systems — voice receptionist, missed-call text-back, review engine, local SEO, Google Business Profile management, CRM, booking, reputation monitoring — from £97/month, no lock-in, live in 10 days.

## What Kerblabs does

Kerblabs is a bundled platform of eight AI and automation systems designed for independent local businesses with under 10 staff and no dedicated marketing team. Pricing starts at £97/month (Spark) and scales to £497/month (Full Engine) with four tiers in between. Setup takes 10 days, there is no lock-in, and the service is fully remote across the UK and now across the US for the med-spa vertical.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://kerblabs.com/): Full-stack AI marketing agency for local businesses — overview, services, pricing, case studies, and demo booking.
- [Services hub](https://kerblabs.com/services): All eight AI services in one place, ranked by impact.
- [Industries hub](https://kerblabs.com/industries): All 30+ UK industry verticals plus the US med-spa vertical, each with a dedicated playbook page.
- [Locations hub](https://kerblabs.com/locations): All 25 major UK cities Kerblabs has dedicated pages for.
- [About](https://kerblabs.com/about): Company and founder background.
- [Pricing](https://kerblabs.com/#pricing): Four tiers — Spark £97/mo, Momentum £197/mo, Autopilot £347/mo, Full Engine £497/mo.
- [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/hello-kerblabs/15-min-discovery-call): 30-minute strategy call.

## Services (8 bundled AI systems)

- [AI Voice Receptionist](https://kerblabs.com/services/ai-voice-receptionist): 24/7 AI phone agent that answers every call, qualifies leads, and books appointments in a natural UK voice. From £347/mo (Autopilot).
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://kerblabs.com/services/missed-call-text-back): Instant personalised SMS to every missed caller within 30 seconds. From £197/mo (Momentum).
- [Review Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/review-management): Automated review requests after every job, with negative-review interception before they go public. From £197/mo (Momentum).
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/google-business-profile-management): Full GBP rewrite, weekly posts, Q&A seeding, photo strategy. From £97/mo (Spark).
- [Local SEO](https://kerblabs.com/services/local-seo): Google Map-Pack ranking optimisation, on-page SEO, location pages, schema, citations. From £197/mo (Momentum).
- [CRM & Pipeline Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/crm-pipeline-management): Unified lead tracking across SMS, email, calls, and web. From £197/mo (Momentum).
- [Booking Calendar & Reminders](https://kerblabs.com/services/booking-calendar-reminders): Online booking with automated SMS reminders that cut no-shows by 30–40%. From £97/mo (Spark).
- [Reputation Monitoring](https://kerblabs.com/services/reputation-monitoring): Real-time alerts on every new review and brand mention across Google, Facebook, Trustpilot. From £97/mo (Spark).

## Pricing tiers

- Spark — £97/mo + £297 one-time setup. GBP management, review monitoring, booking + reminders.
- Momentum — £197/mo + £497 setup. Adds missed-call text-back, review automation, local SEO, CRM.
- Autopilot — £347/mo + £797 setup. Adds the AI voice receptionist.
- Full Engine — £497/mo + £1,200 setup. Every service, full integration, priority support.

Med-spa (US) pricing is denominated in USD with equivalent tiers.

## Key entity facts

- Legal name: Kerblabs Ltd
- Headquarters country: United Kingdom
- Markets served: United Kingdom (all 4 nations), United States (med-spa vertical only, 2026 launch)
- Service model: fully remote / virtual; no physical offices
- Languages: English (en-GB primary, en-US for US pages)
- Booking link: https://calendly.com/hello-kerblabs/15-min-discovery-call

## What Kerblabs is NOT

- Not a traditional marketing agency (no monthly retainers with junior account managers, no 12-month contracts)
- Not a single-product SaaS (eight bundled systems delivered by one team)
- Not local to one city (UK-wide and now US remote delivery)
- Not a generalist agency (each industry has its own playbook, copy, and FAQ set)
